title: A tree and its fruit
author: Hajime Murai
note: 2022 downloadable source snapshot. Relationship labels are source data; explanation wording is ChiFold editorial. Source Bible quotations are excluded. Subverse elements show whole verses as context.

nodes.label: B
nodes.title:
The relationships between the trees and the fruits.
The outer correspondence is about how to know people by their fuits. The inner correspondence is about relationship between trees and fruits. The structure warns about false prophets and recommends to discern them by their behaviours and results
